title: Federation fixture probe failure at 0 ms: on the first recurrence, tell the fixture preface-timeout race from an OS-level loopback connect failure
outcome: Federation fixture probe failure at 0 ms: on the first recurrence, tell the fixture preface-timeout race from an OS-level loopback connect failure
acceptance: On the first recurrence of the onboarding-probe transport failure (controlTaskDropped at 0 ms), or a deterministic reproduction, the preserved run's diagnostics (the RPC diagnostics from b35c79d1 and the preface-drop line from the w-2f9db62028e0 fix) identify which remaining candidate occurred: the fixture preface-timeout race or an OS/product loopback connect failure.

If the candidate is not one the w-2f9db62028e0 fix addresses, it is fixed where it lives, with a deterministic behaviour test, no wall-clock thresholds and no retries. If it is the addressed candidate, the item records why that fix did not hold, and fixes that.
